_retired: 2026-06-11 — services sunset (Phase 9). Kept as the historical price record; pages 301 to /studio/ per _redirects. check-pricing-consistency skips while this flag is set and no service page exists.
_comment: Canonical price for each productized service. Single source of truth used by scripts/check-pricing-consistency.mjs. When a price changes, update HERE first; the guard then surfaces every HTML page that's still on the old number. `price` is the canonical EN string; `price_variants` lists alternate forms permitted in body prose / ES-locale formatting. The guard accepts any of the variants as a valid mention.
